summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing the commencement of its 2026 drilling campaign and a drilling partnership with Forage Anicinape at the Duparquet Gold Project in Quebec, Canada. The filing describes an operational update (12,000-metre drill program) and an Indigenous community partnership, but it does not disclose any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The registrant's role is as the issuer of the operational press release.
